verdict.rationale: Weave's own built-in and custom signals automatically classify agent interactions and surface failure modes inside the product, and LLM-judge scorers produce AI-generated assessments of logged data. These are a form of in-product AI-derived insight. The evidence does not show an in-product assistant that generates natural-language insights or improvement suggestions. Conversational Q&A and iteration over data are delivered only through external coding agents via the MCP server and Skills, which does not count as inside the product. Missing for 10: an in-product AI assistant or chat over traces, AI-generated suggestions for prompt or agent fixes inside the UI, documentation of how signals are generated, and independent hands-on corroboration.
